in_marathi.name: Ekaparna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekaparna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ekaparna means 'One–Bearing'. In Hindu mythology, Ekaparna refers to Lord Shiva, who carries the goddess Parvati on his shoulders. This name symbolizes love, compassion, and the divine union of Shiva and Parvati.
